description: This Kotlin source file defines the NotesWidgetViewsFactory class, which provides data and views for a notes widget in an Android application. It manages loading, formatting, and presenting note data in a widget interface.

classes.name: NotesWidgetViewsFactory
classes.description: A factory class for providing RemoteViews for each note in the widget, handling data loading, view creation, and user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup when the factory is created.

methods.name: onDataSetChanged
methods.description: Loads and filters the notes data when the widget data is refreshed.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Clears the notes data when the factory is destroyed.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of notes to display.

methods.name: getViewAt
methods.description: Creates and returns the RemoteViews for a specific note at the given position.

methods.name: getLoadingView
methods.description: Returns null, indicating default loading view.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of different view types, which is 1.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the note at the given position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that item IDs are stable.
